acceptance_checks: ID allocation is collision-resistant or based on GitHub identifiers.
State writes are atomic or safely retried.
Dispatch and MergeGate use the same lock matcher.
Lock matcher handles exact, glob, prefix, and documented semantic overlap.
Tests cover collisions, lock conflicts, and forged evidence.
non_goals: Do not introduce an external database unless justified by ADR.
scope: Replace race-prone ID allocation, add safe state write semantics, unify lock matching, and prevent forged PR-local evidence from satisfying MergeGate.
title: Fix state concurrency, IDs, locks, and evidence integrity
